# DART LZH decoder provenance

`src/DartLzh.h` adapts the adaptive Huffman initialization, update and symbol
decode from CiderPress2 `DiskArc/Comp/LZHufStream.cs`, commit
`7a055a200e31f752f3a92bb9fe6ae6f67cd55534`, Copyright 2025 faddenSoft,
under Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE in this directory). POM68K's modifications use
bounded spans, a strict bit reader and canonical distance decoding. The
decoder handles only DART's independently coded 20,960-byte chunks, so the
frequency-halving reconstruction threshold cannot be reached. No compressor
or streaming API is imported. DART uses a zero-filled window and no length
prefix. This Apache-2.0 component is combined with the GPLv3 application.

Format parsing/writing in `src/DartImage.h` is local code, cross-checked with
CiderPress2 `Disk/DART.cs`, its DART format notes and Snow's loader at
`23a41e787e7c4f58fc0915da8d6e35b61faabff8`. Independent compressed test vectors
are generated by retrocompressor 1.0.1, the same codec dependency Snow uses;
the test generator is not needed to build or run POM68K.
